import { serve } from '@hono/node-server';
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import { logger } from 'hono/logger';
import { cors } from 'hono/cors';
import { config } from './config';
import { artifactsRouter } from './routes/artifacts';
import { healthRouter } from './routes/health';
import { authMiddleware } from './middleware/auth';

const app = new Hono();

// Global middleware
app.use('*', logger());
app.use('*', cors());

// Health check (no auth required)
app.route('/health', healthRouter);

// API routes (auth required)
app.use('/api/*', authMiddleware);
app.route('/api/artifacts', artifactsRouter);

// Start server
const port = config.port;
console.log(`Starting Artifact Engine on port ${port}...`);

serve({
  fetch: app.fetch,
  port,
});

console.log(`Artifact Engine running at http://localhost:${port}`);

export default app;
</result>

I've completed a warmup exploration of the codebase. Here's what I found:

## Artifact Engine - Codebase Overview

**Purpose**: AI-powered artifact generation engine using Claude on AWS Bedrock

**Tech Stack**:
- **Runtime**: Node.js (>=18)
- **Framework**: Hono (lightweight web framework)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **AI SDK**: @anthropic-ai/bedrock-sdk
- **Validation**: Zod
- **Caching**: lru-cache
- **Testing**: Jest

**Project Structure**:
```
src/
  index.ts           - Main entry point, Hono server setup
  artifact-manager.ts - Core artifact generation logic
  bedrock-client.ts  - AWS Bedrock/Claude client
  cache.ts           - LRU caching layer
  config.ts          - Configuration management
  schemas.ts         - Zod validation schemas
  types.ts           - TypeScript type definitions
  middleware/
    auth.ts          - Authentication middleware
  routes/
    artifacts.ts     - Artifact API endpoints
    health.ts        - Health check endpoint
tests/
  *.test.ts          - Jest test files
  setup.ts           - Test configuration
```

**Key Patterns**:
- Hono router-based architecture
- Middleware for auth and logging
- Zod schemas for request validation
- LRU cache for performance
- Clean separation of concerns
